Ivy (CSM): quick ask - can we get a tiny customer-facing runbook for onboarding: warmup, batching, streaming fallback, TTLs, and a renewal-risk checklist? need copy for AE kickoff.
Liam (SE): sure. super-compact version below.
Liam (SE): TL;DR: prefill 30-90m before peak, batch 4-8 for low-latency routes, enable streaming with client cutoff 2s and server fallback.
Liam (SE): Redwood-side: prefill API + warm pools, verified low-latency fallback, canary rollouts, alerting for p95 and 5xx.
Liam (SE): Customer-side: run preflight (3 prompts), schedule 15m warmup, set cache TTLs (session 30-60m, ephemeral 10-15m), stop retries after 3 attempts.
Nora (CS Ops): renewal-risk flags to surface: usage_drop_pct >30% after day 14, prefill_success_rate <90% during warmup, sustained fallback_rate rise.
Ivy (CSM): perfect. please format as single slide and add the curl prefill example.
Liam (SE): curl one-liner:
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"ACME","prompts":["hi","summarize:1 line","extract key"]}'
InfraBot: prefill job pf_9001 queued for tenant ACME (requested by Liam).
Ivy (CSM): thanks team 44d
